jds.title: Warehouse Operations Lead — Columbus Hub
paragraphs: Lead a crew of 18 on the Columbus cross-dock, from inbound scheduling to outbound load quality.
Pay: $31.50 per hour, plus a $2.25 shift differential.
Shift: second shift, 2 p.m. to 10:30 p.m., Monday to Friday.
Experience: 3+ years leading a warehouse or cross-dock crew; forklift certification within 30 days of hire.
Interview loop: recruiter screen, floor walk with the site manager, and a scheduling exercise.
